components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
a11y: Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
a11y: danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert dialog
components.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action.
a11y: role="alertdialog" with a name from the title and a description.
Focus moves to the Cancel button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape cancels; focus is trapped; the page behind is inert.
Clicking the overlay does not close it.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect ratio
components.description: Keep media or a placeholder at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
a11y: A plain div; the content keeps its own semantics and alt text.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
a11y: name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.

components.name: avatar-group
components.title: Avatar group
components.description: Overlap several avatars and show how many more there are.
a11y: role="group" with an accessible name; the overflow count is plain text.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A short status word or count.
a11y: Plain text in a span; the word carries the meaning, not the colour.
For a count that changes, put it inside an aria-live region yourself.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: The path to the current page.
a11y: A nav landmark with an aria-label, containing an ordered list.
The current page has aria-current=page and is not a link.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
a11y: Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button group
components.description: Join related buttons into one segmented bar.
a11y: role="group" with a required accessible name.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open.
a11y: Plain divs and a heading; no roles added.
With asChild on a link or button the whole card is one keyboard-focusable control.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state.
a11y: role=checkbox; Space toggles; Tab focuses.
indeterminate is exposed as aria-checked=mixed.
A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.

components.name: code-block
components.title: Code block
components.description: A block of code with a copy button.
a11y: The code is a pre/code element; the region has an accessible name.
The copy button is announced as "Copy code" and confirms with a polite live message.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: Show or hide one region of content from a trigger.
a11y: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Space and Enter toggle it.

components.name: container
components.title: Container
components.description: Centre content in a column with a sensible maximum width and side padding.
a11y: A plain div; adds no roles.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context menu
components.description: A menu of actions opened by right click or long press on an area.
a11y: Opens with right click, long press or the context-menu key (Shift+F10).
Arrow keys move, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus.
Every action must also exist elsewhere in the UI for people who cannot open it.

components.name: description-list
components.title: Description list
components.description: Label and value pairs, like the details of a record.
a11y: A native dl with dt and dd, so assistive tech pairs each label with its value.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal window for a question or short task that blocks the page.
a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal; the title names it and the description describes it.
Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped there, and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape and the Close button close it; the page behind is inert.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for secondary tasks, details or navigation.
a11y: role="dialog" named by the title.
Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape and the overlay close it.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown menu
components.description: A list of actions that opens from a button.
a11y: role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items.
Arrow keys move, Enter and Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus, type-ahead jumps to an item.
The trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty state
components.description: Say that there is nothing here yet and offer the next step.
a11y: Plain heading and text; put the action in children as a button or link.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA.
a11y: The label is bound to the control by id, so it has an accessible name.
Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced via role=alert.
required sets the native required attribute on the control.

components.name: fieldset
components.title: Fieldset
components.description: Group related controls under one legend.
a11y: Native fieldset and legend: screen readers announce the legend with each control.
disabled on the fieldset disables every control inside.

components.name: grid
components.title: Grid
components.description: A responsive grid of equal columns with one gap.
a11y: A plain div; source order is reading order.

components.name: heading
components.title: Heading
components.description: A heading whose level (for structure) is separate from its size (for looks).
a11y: Renders a real h1 to h6; choose the level for the outline, not the size.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover card
components.description: Preview extra content when a link or element is hovered or focused.
a11y: Opens on pointer hover and on keyboard focus of the trigger.
Supplementary only: never put the sole path to information or actions in it.
Not shown on touch devices; the trigger must work on its own.

components.name: icon-button
components.title: Icon button
components.description: A square button holding only an icon. The accessible name is required.
a11y: Native button; aria-label is required by the type.
Space and Enter activate it.

components.name: image
components.title: Image
components.description: An image with required alt text, a ratio, and a fallback when it fails to load.
a11y: alt is required; use alt="" only for purely decorative images.
The fallback shows the alt text so the content is not lost when loading fails.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A single-line text field.
a11y: Native <input>: all keyboard and autofill behaviour is the browser's.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Show a keyboard key or shortcut.
a11y: Native kbd element, announced as text.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: The visible name of a form control.
a11y: A real <label>: clicking it focuses the control it names.
required adds a visual marker; set required on the control for assistive tech.

components.name: link
components.title: Link
components.description: An underlined link. External links open safely and say so.
a11y: A real anchor with a visible underline; focus ring shared with other controls.
External links get rel="noopener noreferrer" and a hidden "(opens in a new tab)".

components.name: marquee
components.title: Marquee
components.description: Scroll a row of items endlessly; pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion.
a11y: The duplicate copy is aria-hidden so screen readers read the items once.
Pauses on hover and focus; animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like File, Edit and View in a desktop app.
a11y: role="menubar"; arrow keys move between menus and items, Enter or Space opens.
Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to its trigger.

components.name: native-select
components.title: Native select
components.description: The browser select, styled. Best on mobile and for long simple lists.
a11y: A real select element: native keyboard, typeahead and mobile pickers.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically.

components.name: number-input
components.title: Number input
components.description: A numeric field with decrease and increase buttons.
a11y: Native input type="number"; ArrowUp/ArrowDown change the value.
The step buttons are named "Decrease" and "Increase" and are skipped by Tab.

components.name: otp-input
components.title: OTP input
components.description: Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support.
a11y: The boxes are a group with a name; each box is labelled "Digit N of M".
Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrows move, pasting fills all boxes.
inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" for mobile and autofill.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Move between pages of results.
a11y: A nav landmark; each page is a button named "Page N" and the current one has aria-current=page.
Prev and Next are disabled at the ends.
The gap marker is hidden from assistive tech.

components.name: password-input
components.title: Password input
components.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle.
a11y: The toggle is a button with aria-pressed named "Show password".
The field keeps autocomplete hints so password managers work.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A floating panel of content or controls anchored to a button.
a11y: The trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role=dialog.
Focus moves into the panel; Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: How far along a task is, or that it is still working.
a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Indeterminate omits aria-valuenow.
aria-label is required.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio group
components.description: Pick exactly one option from a short list.
a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio items; one Tab stop for the group.
Arrow keys move and select; Space selects the focused item.
Give the group an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

components.name: rating
components.title: Rating
components.description: Pick or show a score from 1 to a maximum, as stars.
a11y: Editable: a radio group (native radios) with arrow-key selection; each star is named "N of M".
Read-only: role="img" with a text label such as "4 out of 5".

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll area
components.description: A scrollable region with thin, themed scrollbars.
a11y: The viewport is focusable (tabindex 0) so keyboard users can scroll it; give it an aria-label when it holds standalone content.
Native scrolling semantics are preserved.

components.name: segmented-control
components.title: Segmented control
components.description: Pick exactly one option from a short row, shown as joined segments.
a11y: A named radio group; arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump.
One option is always selected: pressing the active one does nothing.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Pick one value from a list of five or more options.
a11y: Trigger is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the list is role=listbox with option items.
Arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
Inside a Field it is labelled by the Field's label.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: A thin rule between groups.
a11y: Decorative by default: role=none so screen readers skip it.
With decorative=false it is role=separator with aria-orientation.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A still placeholder shaped like the content that is loading.
a11y: aria-hidden: it carries no information.
Pair with an aria-busy region or a Spinner so loading is announced once.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Pick a number, or a range, by dragging or with the keyboard.
a11y: Each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuenow, min and max.
Arrow keys step; Home and End jump to the ends; PageUp and PageDown take larger steps.
aria-label is required; a range labels its thumbs minimum and maximum.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: A small indicator that something is loading.
a11y: role=status with an aria-label; polite, not interrupting.
Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: Lay children out in a column or row with one gap from the spacing scale.
a11y: A plain div; adds no roles.

components.name: stat
components.title: Stat
components.description: One number with its label and a note.
a11y: A description list (dl) pairs the label with its value.

components.name: stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.description: Show progress through a numbered sequence of steps.
a11y: An ordered list; the current step has aria-current="step".
Completed steps are marked in text for assistive tech, not by colour alone.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.
a11y: role=switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle.
A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Rows and columns of data with a header, in a horizontally scrolling wrapper.
a11y: Native table elements with th scope and an optional caption.
The scroll wrapper is focusable and named so keyboard users can scroll wide tables.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switch between related views in the same place.
a11y: role=tablist, tab and tabpanel with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump; only the active tab is a Tab stop.
Give the list an accessible name with aria-label.

components.name: tag
components.title: Tag
components.description: A short label, optionally removable.
a11y: The remove control is a real button named "Remove <label>".

components.name: text
components.title: Text
components.description: Body text with a size and tone from the scale.
a11y: A plain p (or the child with asChild); tone is never the only signal, so pair danger text with words.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field.
a11y: Native <textarea>.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.

components.name: timeline
components.title: Timeline
components.description: A vertical list of events with times, joined by a rule.
a11y: An ordered list of events; the time is a real time element when a datetime is given.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A short message that appears briefly and does not block the page.
a11y: Announced politely by assistive tech without moving focus.
Pauses its timer on hover and focus; F8 jumps focus to the toast region.
Never the only place a critical result appears; keep an inline message too.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed or not.
a11y: A button with aria-pressed; Space and Enter toggle it.
Icon-only toggles need an aria-label.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle group
components.description: A row of toggles where one or several can be on.
a11y: single type is role=radiogroup with radio items; multiple type is a group of toggle buttons.
Arrow keys move focus between items; Space and Enter toggle.
Give the group an aria-label.

components.name: toolbar
components.title: Toolbar
components.description: A row of related controls that share one tab stop and arrow-key movement.
a11y: role="toolbar" with a required name; one Tab stop, arrow keys move between controls.
Home and End jump to the first and last control.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus.
a11y: Shows on hover and on keyboard focus; the trigger gets aria-describedby while it is open.
Escape dismisses it; it stays open while the pointer is over it.
Never the only place for essential information: touch users do not get hover.
